steering_ledger.verbatim: 1. **PR #32820 (merged 2026-11-23).** What it does: tests compare only GATED_DELTA_NET snapshot slot 0 when n_tokens > K, since ggml.h guarantees only slot 0 there. How it was found: gpu-rocm (gfx1151) CI failures on the chunked path. Results: RTX PRO 6000 test-backend-ops went 82/84 → 84/84. Restricting the chunked kernel to K==1 would make K=5 PP-2048 2.4x slower. Scope: backend-generic contract; applies to HIP on gfx90a. Value: follow-up to intake-2796 (pr32456); the snapshot contract for DTREE-GDN-BATCH, GDN-FUSED-VARIANT/GDN-COLWIDTH, and the C20/C21 fold gates.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2867): the in-house CDNA chunked kernel writes every tail slot and rollback reads them, so the contract is pinned by a witness test rather than ported.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 2. **PR #32177 (open).** What it does: mul_mat_id aborts when a ubatch exceeds smpbo/4 tokens (25344 on ~99 KB-smem GPUs). The PR adds a pre-pass plus chunked compaction of expert ids, and 66000-token test-backend-ops cases. Scope: CUDA source that the HIP build shares. gfx90a has 64 KB LDS, so the limit is lower there (verify). Value: A3B large-ubatch prefill robustness; the MMID lane after AK-A3B-VERIFY-DEDUP DROP.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2868): ceiling derived as 16384 tokens on gfx90a; guard plus op smoke filed, the fold waits on the n_used helper fold (M3).

steering_ledger.verbatim: 3. **PR #32533 (open).** What it does: BF16 src1 for MUL_MAT/MUL_MAT_ID on CPU and CUDA. RTX 5090 results, us/run: MUL_MAT_ID, Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K, 512 tok: 170.60 → 156.24 (−8.4%). IQ4_XS: −4.8%. F8_E4M3 MUL_MAT, 1 tok: −12.8%. Reviewer notes: MMVF branch cost, and a bundled int32 overflow fix. Scope: CUDA-side; HIP coverage on gfx90a unverified. The CPU path converts BF16 src1 to vec_dot_type. Value: DF2-11 / DF2-11-BF16-FIX; the BF16 drafter currently runs via hipBLAS/Tensile at 144 GB/s. Specifically: templated src1 type in quantizers vs a runtime flag in MMVF; dispatch of BF16 src1 to MMQ/MMVQ vs BLAS.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2869): the PR cannot route the drafter (BF16 weights, F32 src1); two latent MMVF fixes and a dtype rule are filed, the feature port is declined.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 4. **Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper (2611.30027).** Results: vLLM's NVFP4 KV path runs at 10–20% of bandwidth, up to 1.7x slower than FP8. The new kernel reaches 67–75% of peak at batch 32–128, 1.12–1.49x over the faster of XQA and FA4 FP8 at all 11 shapes. In vLLM: 1.12–1.64x per step on Llama-3.1-8B vs FlashInfer FP8 at batch ≥8, with 1.63x token capacity; prefill is 7% slower. Qwen2-family layer-0 key mean = k-proj bias through RoPE; keeping layer 0 in BF16 restores FP8/4-bit KV. Scope: Hopper-only (TMA, warpgroups). No FP4 hardware is assumed, so the software decode transfers. Value: G3-KTRACE (q4_0 KV full dequant), AK-GVFATTN-LONGCTX (LDS cut at 1.21x, below the bar), and KLD gates on KV quant. NOTE: a q4_0 KV gv_fattn kernel is being designed in this session right now (row `ak-gvfattn-q4kv-gpu-20261124` may exist). Cross-reference it. Specifically: a write-time cache layout so decoded values feed MFMA from registers; producer/consumer overlap of load and decode; operand swap to avoid padding small GQA groups; issue-budget-per-byte accounting; K mean removal plus BF16 layer 0 plus BF16 sink tokens.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2870) with four wave-1 companions; the row ak-gvfattn-q4kv-gpu-20261124 is absent from the lane at f74b175, so the design box hands its inputs to that row if it exists at Stage 4. Accuracy arms are P3.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 5. **KernelShift (2611.29590).** Results: 99 CPU kernels from ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops and KleidiAI. Agents beat auto-vectorization 2.4–19.8x, reach up to 2.74x over ncnn Neon, and 0.70x of KleidiAI. Agent-written kernels give 1.3–1.6x prefill over llama.cpp's fast path in two LLMs. Agents fail to adapt to SME2 matrix tiles. Scope: Arm-only (Neon/SVE/SVE2/SME2). Value: the AutoKernel CPU lane (AK-CPU-* rows, quarter-24t 112.9 GB/s ceiling), and a benchmark-construction method for AVX-512 kernels. Specifically: the repo-to-benchmark pipeline with target-hardware feedback, and which ISA-extension idioms agents miss. Map the SME2 tile failure to AVX-512/VNNI/BF16 usage.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2871) with the repo and SimdBench; the SME2 failure was streaming-mode state and does not predict VNNI/BF16 behaviour; a one-op x86 pilot is filed.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 6. **Exact on Paper (2611.29663).** Setup: vLLM, one 4B model, nine single-feature configs plus five reference replicas, 3,380 graded requests. Results: Seven exact features flip 1.47% (CI 1.13–1.85) to 1.78% (1.39–2.20) of requests; none is above the 1.72% scheduling floor. FP8 KV flips 3.36% (2.80–3.96), as many as FP8 weights. With batch-invariant kernels, all seven exact features, including spec decode, reproduce the reference text on every request. A single-replica-pair gate rejected an unchanged config. Scope: hardware-agnostic method. Value: DFlash2 np2 A/A parity, SPEC-STALE-1, the C20/C21 fold gates, KLD gates, BSV-2 accept rigor. Highly relevant: tonight this session found that fixed 0.19/0.38 nat identity bands are miscalibrated, and moved to in-row reference-build bands.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2872) with eight wave-1/2 noise-floor sources; the protocol amendment extends the in-row band design rather than replacing it.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 7. **Grammar-as-a-Draft (2611.28349).** Mechanism: grammar-forced tokens are merged into draft rows and accepted without logits. Acceptance length: MTP Qwen3.5-0.8B: 2.06 → 5.43. MTP Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: 1.99 → 5.31. DFlash Qwen3-4B: 1.57 → 4.13. n-gram: 1.30 → 3.64. Speed: 2.66–2.81x at batch 1, 1.14–1.70x at batch 64. Plain-text TPOT +7–42% under mixed traffic. The output distribution changes vs grammar-masked decoding. Scope: TPU v7x with a Rust runtime; scheduler-level, no new kernels, so it ports to llama.cpp grammar plus MTP/DFlash2 on EPYC/MI210. Value: INF-50 DFlash2, the MTP lanes, orchestrator tool-call/JSON paths. Specifically: the draft-row merge/cut rule, and logit-free acceptance of forced tokens inside the fork's accept loops (V2 RRS sampled tree verifier in C21).
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2873, intake-2885): the speedups carry a tokenization artefact; the deciding step is an offline forced-share replay of production json_schema classes.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 8. **Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness (2611.28244).** Setup: MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b and two other models. Results: context folding is best in all six settings, up to +19.2% over recency truncation. Discarding persistently unused lessons beats consolidation or rule promotion. MLEvolver reaches a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and 94% fast_1 on KernelBench Level 3. Scope: hardware-agnostic. Value: AutoKernel loop journal / do-not-repeat lessons, AP-LH-DISTILL, skill-bank pruning, context folding (intake-154 / CF-AB-1).
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2874, intake-2903): demote rules are replayed offline on prose lessons only; gate-backed negatives are never demoted. The CF-AB-1 arm is P8.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 9. **DMC-5 (2611.30412).** Design: append-only canonical view, a general compressor model, and a specialized agent model working on a compact decision view. Results: agent input −38.5–57.0%, end-to-end cost −14.5–28.0%, compressor cache-hit 78.0–85.0%, task performance +1.0–5.8% on AppWorld, OfficeBench and 8-objective QA. Scope: hardware-agnostic. Value: KV-EVICT-COST-1, prefix-cache-stable compaction, orchestrator routing between small and large Qwen roles.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2875, intake-2902): the cost saving is an API price effect; the local question is a seconds break-even column in the evict-cost table plus the integrity ledger.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 10. **CCAMoE (2611.28550).** Design: cache-only drafting from resident target experts (no draft weights), draft-guided expert-cache updates that overlap transfers, and cost-aware draft length. Result: up to 2.33x lower decoding latency vs state of the art, across MoE models and GPU platforms. Scope: built for GPU expert offloading; the principles apply to EPYC+MI210 A3B hybrid placement. Value: A3B MTP serving, hybrid CPU-GPU MoE placement, draft_p_min/draft-length control. Specifically: expert residency as drafter, PCIe Gen4 transfer overlap, and the acceptance-vs-cost draft-length rule. Extract the performance principles and check MI210/EPYC applicability, as for items 1–5.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2876) with SpecMoE and S2-MoE: the 2.33x is one RTX 4090 cell; transfer overlap does not pay against a DRAM-resident A3B; the stop rule is replayed offline against p_min.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 11. **Which Loopholes Get Found? (2611.29651).** Setup: 36 GRPO runs, seven judges. Results: In all 12 exploiting runs, the first exploited pattern had the highest exposure (policy propensity × judge FPR); highest FPR alone predicted it in only 6. With two seeded patterns at 3–3.8% of SFT data, exposure named the first exploit and its onset window in all six runs. Exploitation happened only on hard prompts. Scope: hardware-agnostic. Value: LLM-as-judge audits before local Qwen RLVR/GRPO, AutoPilot judge gates, eval rigor.
steering_ledger.reason: Dived (intake-2877) with five judge/verifier companions: no current gate optimises against an LLM judge, so the audit runs before any optimiser does.

P1.project_objective: Remove the per-row GDN snapshot-write cost from speculative verify on the 27B, A3B and Q38FN, and free recurrent-state memory at np > 1.
P1.implementation_ref: C17 ed5d94969 GDN kernels (one column per warp; F32/BF16 state, tree, GDN-ROWS, H15 variants); program.md L700 snapshot-floor learning; PR #31669 head 93252b852acc
P1.gap: Our verify path writes (1+n_rs_seq) recurrent snapshots per step (about 3.1 MB per layer per row on the 27B); the program learning calls this floor unavoidable; no replay path exists in the fork.
P1.operational_change: Port replay as default-off behind LLAMA_RS_REPLAY, gate it per served recipe, write the tree-replay design note, correct the learning, and run three zero-inference reads (UFH14-A7 re-scoped against C17 PFXC-A1, checkpoint cut counts, whether snapshot slots already hold the n-4 state) that price split-free checkpoints.
P1.benefit_direction: Lower verify-step cost and recurrent memory at np > 1 (inferred about 1% at np 1 on the MI210, larger at np 4; 1-8% per CPU round, unmeasured); output tokens must stay identical.
P1.execution_conditions: Implementation on llama.cpp-experimental from C17 only (production frozen); isolated GPU and CPU rows through rowflow; activation only through the champion fold gate.
P1.closure_basis: Split-free checkpoint prototype stays trigger prose (M2) until KPF-64-CUTS shows material cut cost and the port has landed.

proposed_tasks.task_text: - [ ] **RS-REPLAY-PORT** [non-inference] Forward-port llama.cpp PR #31669 GDN input-log replay onto a fresh llama.cpp-experimental branch from champion C17 ed5d94969, one feature per commit: the op keep parameter and CPU replay, test-backend-ops cases, the replay loop in our gfx90a GDN kernel variants (F32 and BF16 state, tree, GDN-ROWS, H15), the replay-only launch before chunked prefill, and the pending-row and conv column-history memory side, default-off behind LLAMA_RS_REPLAY (intake-2752#record, intake-2771#record).

- [ ] **RS-REPLAY-GATE** [inference] Gate GDN input-log replay against snapshot rollback on the served speculative recipes: 27B DFlash2 at np 1 and np 4 and A3B MTP on the MI210, and Q38FN MTP on the CPU, measuring token identity, recurrent-state memory, tok/s and np 4 GDN kernel wall time at n_max 7 and 15; the identity gate applies only to F32 raw-input logs replayed in the same order, any F16 or reordered variant is gated by KLD instead (intake-2752#record, intake-2771#record).

- [ ] **DTREE-REPLAY-DESIGN** [non-inference] Write the tree-replay design note: log per-column GDN inputs during tree verify and replay only the accepted path at llama_memory_tree_accept instead of keeping one recurrent snapshot per tree slot, and estimate the round-cost change against the measured DTREE-ROUND-OVERHEAD-2 gap (intake-2752#record).

- [ ] **AK-LEARN-GDN-REPLAY** [non-inference] Amend two learnings in the AutoKernel program.md: the GDN snapshot-write floor is avoidable by input-log replay (the remaining floor is one state write per step), and the tree cost model holds exactly only when a is the fractional increase in accepted tokens per round, with TALON's drafter-side term noted (intake-2752#record, intake-2769#record).

- [ ] **FR-UFH14-DIVERGE** [non-inference] Re-scope UFH14-A7 against champion C17, which already checkpoints at end of generation (PFXC-A1, default on; the UFH14-A7 code read was v10), and classify the 41 divergent turns by where the first divergence starts relative to the previous assistant output, to decide whether anything beyond PFXC-A1 is needed (intake-2758#record, intake-2772#record, intake-2787#record).

- [ ] **KPF-64-CUTS** [non-inference] Count checkpoint-induced extra ubatches (prefill cuts) per request and their wall time from existing llama-server -lv 4 logs of the served recipes, to price split-free checkpointing (intake-2758#record, intake-2787#record).

- [ ] **KPF-64-SNAPSLOT-READ** [non-inference] Code-read on C17 whether, with speculation on (n_rs_seq >= 4), the last prompt ubatch's GDN K-snapshot slots and conv history already hold the state at n-4, so the server's n-4 checkpoint batch cut could be replaced by a snapshot-slot copy into the checkpoint with no kernel change (intake-2772#record).

- [ ] **AK-GAP-1-STOCH-CENSUS** [inference] Census the temperature-1 speculative recipe on C17: split the inter-graph host share of the 27B DFlash2 :8083 recipe at temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20 into logits copy-out, host sampling and the accept loop with the ak-gap-1-step1 tooling, because LLAMA_DEVICE_ACCEPT covers the greedy path only (intake-2755#record).

- [ ] **AK-GAP-1-STOCH-ACCEPT** [inference] Build a default-off device stochastic accept for temperature > 0 speculative verify on gfx90a: apply temperature, top-p and min-p in logit space to the TOPK_FAST candidates, run the rejection test with pre-drawn uniforms passed as a graph input, emit accepted count and the residual-resampled token, with the host path as the oracle, then A/B it (intake-2755#record).

- [ ] **Q38FN-CPU-SAMPLER-SPLIT** [inference] Attribute the non-forward share of the Q38FN CPU MTP round (sampler top-k and sort, drafter, host bookkeeping) with one perf timestamp pass, and port a tile-local packed-key AVX-512 top-k with deterministic tie order only if the sampler is >= 3% of the round (intake-2755#record).

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-4-PREREG-V2** [non-inference] Amend the TOC-CMP-4 pre-registration with the CompAct-Bench controls and two new arms before the next run: pre-filter points to tasks solved in all uncompacted repeats, a matched post-boundary action budget, retention-ratio matching with a self-built IRC calibration at a 10% character target, a no-history no-summary persistence-floor arm, 25/50/75% boundary placement, the six-type error annotation on failed continuations, a prose-only plus frozen append-only summary arm run in a progressive indexed form (fixed-size segments summarised as they close, each summary appended after the unchanged prefix and never rewritten; not blocked on kv-prefix-fork P1), a per-arm prefix-cache reuse tally (cached prompt tokens over prompt tokens from the slot logs) recorded beside accuracy and cost, and an async compaction plus next-k judge arm blocked on kv-prefix-fork P1 (intake-2762#record, intake-2778#record, intake-2761#record, intake-2770#record, intake-2786#record).

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-NONPROSE-TALLY** [non-inference] Tally, over existing trajectory artifacts, the share of context tokens that are non-prose (file, shell, SQL, test output) versus prose per role, to size the prose-only compaction arm (intake-2761#record).

- [ ] **TOC-CMP-JUDGE-SHIM** [non-inference] Write a llama-server judge shim for compaction validation: port Slipstream's V2-Fast alignment and non-contradiction judge prompt with a GBNF single-integer grammar and enable_thinking false, and test it offline on our own retained compaction transcripts (intake-2779#record).

proposed_tasks.task_text: - [ ] **SPEC-STALE-1** [non-inference] Port two upstream spec-accept fixes to a fresh llama.cpp-experimental branch from champion eee3da8, one feature per commit (intake-2803#record, intake-2811#record, intake-2799#record): (a) stop accepting draft tokens at an EOG that is not the last draft token in all three accept loops of common/sampling.cpp (plain ~:708, greedy-fast ~:928, rejection ~:960-1035; #29638 + philippesic ed1254a shape); (b) when a stop string or n_predict ends generation inside an accepted draft, trim the tokens after the stop from slot.prompt.tokens and the memory once per round (#32771 shape) using OUR use_ckpt_tgt (server-context.cpp:5976, n_rollback-based). Tests: unit test {eog,eog}->1, {eog}->2; the 48-EOG ngram tail case from #28232; an EOG at accepted row 0 on the checkpoint-restore round must terminate in one extra round; spec-on vs spec-off tokens_cached parity over 20 stop words on DFlash2 and MTP types, -np 1 and -np 2. No inference row unless the parity test shows stale tokens on our accept path.

- [ ] **PFXC-SAVE-1** [non-inference] Price the prompt-cache save path from evidence we already have before any port (intake-2800#record, intake-2823#record, intake-2809#record, intake-2810#record): (1) read the retained LLAMA_LB7_PROBES lines (alloc_us, idle_save_us, n_ranges, checkpoint-list size, prompt_save/prompt_load ms) for :8083 and :8070 and report P50/P95 save and restore ms and their share of TTFT; (2) read /proc/<pid>/smaps AnonHugePages for one live :8083 server during a served window (read-only); (3) grep launchers and stack configs for GGML_NOHUGEPAGE_PROCESS=1. Then decide: if save P95 >= 50 ms or >= 1% of the TTFT tail, open the port box (upstream #30137 reference-counted checkpoints + no-zero-fill buffers + #32758's restore-retry fix, with checkpoint accounting deduped by pointer); otherwise close as no-gain. THP flag and glibc.malloc.hugetlb are not adopted (host THP is `always`).

- [ ] **FOLD-GUARD-H12** [non-inference] Upstream-fold guard for our FA slots (intake-2808#record, intake-2818#record): at the next fresh-from-champion fold that crosses upstream #27970 (8e93a9773) or the fused TOP_K_MASK work, (a) move our FA op_params n_seq from slot 4 to slot 5 behind the accessor (readers fattn-gqa-verify.cu:682/:739, fattn-common.cuh:1079, ggml-cpu/ops.cpp:10428 @ eee3da8) and (b) add a test that asserts H12 still fuses the Q38FN QSA node with n_kv_max set and with the fused top-k-mask op present, failing loudly instead of silently falling back to dense FA.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 1. **PR #32820 (merged 2026-11-23).** What it does: tests compare only GATED_DELTA_NET snapshot slot 0 when n_tokens > K, since ggml.h guarantees only slot 0 there. How it was found: gpu-rocm (gfx1151) CI failures on the chunked path. Results: RTX PRO 6000 test-backend-ops went 82/84 → 84/84. Restricting the chunked kernel to K==1 would make K=5 PP-2048 2.4x slower. Scope: backend-generic contract; applies to HIP on gfx90a. Value: follow-up to intake-2796 (pr32456); the snapshot contract for DTREE-GDN-BATCH, GDN-FUSED-VARIANT/GDN-COLWIDTH, and the C20/C21 fold gates.
steering_reconciliation.reason: Dived (intake-2867): the in-house CDNA chunked kernel writes every tail slot and rollback reads them, so the contract is pinned by a witness test rather than ported.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 2. **PR #32177 (open).** What it does: mul_mat_id aborts when a ubatch exceeds smpbo/4 tokens (25344 on ~99 KB-smem GPUs). The PR adds a pre-pass plus chunked compaction of expert ids, and 66000-token test-backend-ops cases. Scope: CUDA source that the HIP build shares. gfx90a has 64 KB LDS, so the limit is lower there (verify). Value: A3B large-ubatch prefill robustness; the MMID lane after AK-A3B-VERIFY-DEDUP DROP.
steering_reconciliation.reason: Dived (intake-2868): ceiling derived as 16384 tokens on gfx90a; guard plus op smoke filed, the fold waits on the n_used helper fold (M3).

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 3. **PR #32533 (open).** What it does: BF16 src1 for MUL_MAT/MUL_MAT_ID on CPU and CUDA. RTX 5090 results, us/run: MUL_MAT_ID, Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K, 512 tok: 170.60 → 156.24 (−8.4%). IQ4_XS: −4.8%. F8_E4M3 MUL_MAT, 1 tok: −12.8%. Reviewer notes: MMVF branch cost, and a bundled int32 overflow fix. Scope: CUDA-side; HIP coverage on gfx90a unverified. The CPU path converts BF16 src1 to vec_dot_type. Value: DF2-11 / DF2-11-BF16-FIX; the BF16 drafter currently runs via hipBLAS/Tensile at 144 GB/s. Specifically: templated src1 type in quantizers vs a runtime flag in MMVF; dispatch of BF16 src1 to MMQ/MMVQ vs BLAS.
steering_reconciliation.reason: Dived (intake-2869): the PR cannot route the drafter (BF16 weights, F32 src1); two latent MMVF fixes and a dtype rule are filed, the feature port is declined.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 4. **Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper (2611.30027).** Results: vLLM's NVFP4 KV path runs at 10–20% of bandwidth, up to 1.7x slower than FP8. The new kernel reaches 67–75% of peak at batch 32–128, 1.12–1.49x over the faster of XQA and FA4 FP8 at all 11 shapes. In vLLM: 1.12–1.64x per step on Llama-3.1-8B vs FlashInfer FP8 at batch ≥8, with 1.63x token capacity; prefill is 7% slower. Qwen2-family layer-0 key mean = k-proj bias through RoPE; keeping layer 0 in BF16 restores FP8/4-bit KV. Scope: Hopper-only (TMA, warpgroups). No FP4 hardware is assumed, so the software decode transfers. Value: G3-KTRACE (q4_0 KV full dequant), AK-GVFATTN-LONGCTX (LDS cut at 1.21x, below the bar), and KLD gates on KV quant. NOTE: a q4_0 KV gv_fattn kernel is being designed in this session right now (row `ak-gvfattn-q4kv-gpu-20261124` may exist). Cross-reference it. Specifically: a write-time cache layout so decoded values feed MFMA from registers; producer/consumer overlap of load and decode; operand swap to avoid padding small GQA groups; issue-budget-per-byte accounting; K mean removal plus BF16 layer 0 plus BF16 sink tokens.
steering_reconciliation.reason: Dived (intake-2870) with four wave-1 companions; the row ak-gvfattn-q4kv-gpu-20261124 is absent from the lane at f74b175, so the design box hands its inputs to that row if it exists at Stage 4. Accuracy arms are P3.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 5. **KernelShift (2611.29590).** Results: 99 CPU kernels from ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops and KleidiAI. Agents beat auto-vectorization 2.4–19.8x, reach up to 2.74x over ncnn Neon, and 0.70x of KleidiAI. Agent-written kernels give 1.3–1.6x prefill over llama.cpp's fast path in two LLMs. Agents fail to adapt to SME2 matrix tiles. Scope: Arm-only (Neon/SVE/SVE2/SME2). Value: the AutoKernel CPU lane (AK-CPU-* rows, quarter-24t 112.9 GB/s ceiling), and a benchmark-construction method for AVX-512 kernels. Specifically: the repo-to-benchmark pipeline with target-hardware feedback, and which ISA-extension idioms agents miss. Map the SME2 tile failure to AVX-512/VNNI/BF16 usage.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 6. **Exact on Paper (2611.29663).** Setup: vLLM, one 4B model, nine single-feature configs plus five reference replicas, 3,380 graded requests. Results: Seven exact features flip 1.47% (CI 1.13–1.85) to 1.78% (1.39–2.20) of requests; none is above the 1.72% scheduling floor. FP8 KV flips 3.36% (2.80–3.96), as many as FP8 weights. With batch-invariant kernels, all seven exact features, including spec decode, reproduce the reference text on every request. A single-replica-pair gate rejected an unchanged config. Scope: hardware-agnostic method. Value: DFlash2 np2 A/A parity, SPEC-STALE-1, the C20/C21 fold gates, KLD gates, BSV-2 accept rigor. Highly relevant: tonight this session found that fixed 0.19/0.38 nat identity bands are miscalibrated, and moved to in-row reference-build bands.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 7. **Grammar-as-a-Draft (2611.28349).** Mechanism: grammar-forced tokens are merged into draft rows and accepted without logits. Acceptance length: MTP Qwen3.5-0.8B: 2.06 → 5.43. MTP Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: 1.99 → 5.31. DFlash Qwen3-4B: 1.57 → 4.13. n-gram: 1.30 → 3.64. Speed: 2.66–2.81x at batch 1, 1.14–1.70x at batch 64. Plain-text TPOT +7–42% under mixed traffic. The output distribution changes vs grammar-masked decoding. Scope: TPU v7x with a Rust runtime; scheduler-level, no new kernels, so it ports to llama.cpp grammar plus MTP/DFlash2 on EPYC/MI210. Value: INF-50 DFlash2, the MTP lanes, orchestrator tool-call/JSON paths. Specifically: the draft-row merge/cut rule, and logit-free acceptance of forced tokens inside the fork's accept loops (V2 RRS sampled tree verifier in C21).

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 8. **Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness (2611.28244).** Setup: MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b and two other models. Results: context folding is best in all six settings, up to +19.2% over recency truncation. Discarding persistently unused lessons beats consolidation or rule promotion. MLEvolver reaches a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and 94% fast_1 on KernelBench Level 3. Scope: hardware-agnostic. Value: AutoKernel loop journal / do-not-repeat lessons, AP-LH-DISTILL, skill-bank pruning, context folding (intake-154 / CF-AB-1).

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 9. **DMC-5 (2611.30412).** Design: append-only canonical view, a general compressor model, and a specialized agent model working on a compact decision view. Results: agent input −38.5–57.0%, end-to-end cost −14.5–28.0%, compressor cache-hit 78.0–85.0%, task performance +1.0–5.8% on AppWorld, OfficeBench and 8-objective QA. Scope: hardware-agnostic. Value: KV-EVICT-COST-1, prefix-cache-stable compaction, orchestrator routing between small and large Qwen roles.
steering_reconciliation.reason: Dived (intake-2875, intake-2902): the cost saving is an API price effect; the local question is a seconds break-even column in the evict-cost table plus the integrity ledger.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 10. **CCAMoE (2611.28550).** Design: cache-only drafting from resident target experts (no draft weights), draft-guided expert-cache updates that overlap transfers, and cost-aware draft length. Result: up to 2.33x lower decoding latency vs state of the art, across MoE models and GPU platforms. Scope: built for GPU expert offloading; the principles apply to EPYC+MI210 A3B hybrid placement. Value: A3B MTP serving, hybrid CPU-GPU MoE placement, draft_p_min/draft-length control. Specifically: expert residency as drafter, PCIe Gen4 transfer overlap, and the acceptance-vs-cost draft-length rule. Extract the performance principles and check MI210/EPYC applicability, as for items 1–5.

steering_reconciliation.verbatim: 11. **Which Loopholes Get Found? (2611.29651).** Setup: 36 GRPO runs, seven judges. Results: In all 12 exploiting runs, the first exploited pattern had the highest exposure (policy propensity × judge FPR); highest FPR alone predicted it in only 6. With two seeded patterns at 3–3.8% of SFT data, exposure named the first exploit and its onset window in all six runs. Exploitation happened only on hard prompts. Scope: hardware-agnostic. Value: LLM-as-judge audits before local Qwen RLVR/GRPO, AutoPilot judge gates, eval rigor.
